## Change

Describe the scoped change and the rule or behaviour it affects.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests pass, lint is clean and the build succeeds
- [ ] Python tests and strict pyright pass if jobs changed
- [ ] Docs are updated
- [ ] Data remains synthetic; no identifiers are logged
- [ ] Generated code, secrets and infra state are untouched

List the commands actually run and any limitations.

## Review

Request context-maintainer review for .github/ or AGENTS.md changes, and the relevant readings, billing or jobs maintainer for package changes. Dependency additions need an ADR.
